title: Engineering Data with Precision & Reliability
intro: Architecting robust data foundations for enterprise FinTech systems, ensuring regulatory consistency, schema integrity, and sub-second analytical readiness.
biography: I am a Data Engineer with 1.4 years of professional experience developing enterprise-scale ETL/ELT pipelines and cloud-based data solutions across FinTech and analytics domains. I specialize in designing Medallion (Bronze–Silver–Gold) lakehouses, streaming Change Data Capture (CDC) flows, and establishing automated reconciliation frameworks that safeguard financial transaction integrity.

My hands-on technical core blends Python, PySpark, SQL, and T-SQL with the modern cloud ecosystem: AWS (S3, Glue, DMS, Lambda, Redshift, CloudWatch), Databricks, Delta Lake, Apache Airflow, and dbt. Having delivered production pipelines at Wissen Digital and Endava Solutions, I am experienced in orchestrating incremental processing, leading system cutovers, and resolving mission-critical data discrepancies.
capabilitySubtitle: Battle-tested architectural competencies across the modern data lifecycle
highlights: Star Schema Modeling & Analytical Data Marts

capabilities.title: Pipeline Architecture
capabilities.description: End-to-end batch and streaming ETL/ELT workflows with schema enforcement, idempotent runs, and automated CloudWatch alerting.

capabilities.title: Medallion Lakehouse Design
capabilities.description: Multi-hop storage architecture (Bronze raw ingestion, Silver cleansed/normalized, Gold business dimensions & facts) powered by Delta Lake ACID tables.

capabilities.title: Incremental Processing
capabilities.description: High-performance incremental upserts and data merging utilizing Delta Lake MERGE INTO syntax and Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD Type 1 & 2).

capabilities.title: Change Data Capture (CDC)
capabilities.description: Near real-time relational database replication leveraging AWS DMS binary logs, serverless S3 triggers with AWS Lambda, and AWS Glue curation.

capabilities.title: Data Quality & Reconciliation
capabilities.description: Automated audit frameworks validating schema drift, row count parity, null anomalies, and financial transaction reconciliations.

capabilities.title: Cloud Analytics & Modeling
capabilities.description: Dimensional star schema modeling, Fact and Dimension tables, and query execution plan optimization on Amazon Redshift and Microsoft SQL Server.
